description: a young man healer with short black hair, a long white robe with a brown belt, an olive-yellow hooded mantle, brown shoes, a wooden shepherd staff with small white flowers in his right hand, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
